# Welcome
OceanCube Handbook is the executable guide to the **oceancube 0.2.0 development core**. It complements the Rd reference with concepts, decisions, workflows, and operational policy; the package version remains 0.1.0 until final release preparation.

- Canonical contract: `longitude × latitude × depth × time × variable`
- Backends: in-memory and read-only local NetCDF
- Frozen development API: 38 exports
- Canonical workflow: validate and inspect, select, visualize, aggregate, calculate climatology/anomaly or descriptive trend

Start with @sec-introduction, then use the workflow and function-reference chapters.
